verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment that Elastic's paid subscription tiers include 'fine-grained access control' (elastic-comm-17), plus a note that production security means either the paid security suite or a reverse proxy (elastic-comm-9). Neither describes per-user scoped tokens or document-level filtering within a shared index. Missing for 10: first-party docs on document-level security, scoped or tenant API keys with per-user query filters, evidence that this works without per-user indexes, and hands-on corroboration.
